description: Designs, develops, tests, and maintains application software for various platforms and user needs.
roadmap: Master one programming language (e.g., Python or Java)
Understand Data Structures & Algorithms
Learn OOP principles and design patterns
Get familiar with Git and GitHub
Build desktop or web applications

description: Builds web applications, automation scripts, backend APIs, and data integrations using Python.
roadmap: Learn Python basics and syntax
Understand OOP and Python modules
Learn HTML/CSS and basic web concepts
Master FastAPI or Django framework
Work with databases and ORMs
Deploy Python applications

description: Develops enterprise server-side applications, microservices, and APIs using Java and modern frameworks.
roadmap: Learn Core Java fundamentals & OOP
Practice Data Structures & Algorithms
Learn SQL and Relational Database Design
Master Spring Boot framework & REST API creation
Learn JPA / Hibernate for database integration
Build production-ready backend services

description: Creates responsive web interfaces and full-stack web applications for internet browsers.
roadmap: Learn HTML, CSS, and Responsive Layouts
Master Modern JavaScript (DOM manipulation, async/await)
Understand Git version control
Learn a frontend framework (React/Vue)
Connect frontend to backend REST APIs

description: Inspects, cleans, transforms, and models data to uncover valuable business insights and decision drivers.
roadmap: Master Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables)
Learn SQL for querying databases
Learn Python for data analysis (Pandas & NumPy)
Master Data Visualization tools (Power BI / Tableau)
Analyze real datasets and build dashboards

description: Combines math, statistics, programming, and domain knowledge to extract actionable insight and predictive models from data.
roadmap: Learn Python for Data Science & Math (Linear Algebra, Probabilities)
Master Data Manipulation with Pandas & NumPy
Learn Machine Learning algorithms with Scikit-Learn
Build predictive models and evaluate metrics
Deploy models via web APIs

description: Researches, builds, and deploys Artificial Intelligence models, Large Language Models (LLMs), and deep neural networks.
roadmap: Learn Python & Data Structures
Understand Machine Learning & Deep Learning concepts
Master PyTorch or TensorFlow
Study Natural Language Processing (NLP) & LLMs
Learn how to serve AI models via REST APIs

description: Protects computer systems, networks, and data from cyber threats, unauthorized access, and vulnerabilities.
roadmap: Learn Computer Networking (TCP/IP, DNS, Firewalls)
Understand Linux Operating System & Command Line
Learn Python/Bash scripting for security automation
Study web security fundamentals (OWASP Top 10)
Practice hands-on penetration testing and ethical hacking

description: Architects, deploys, and manages infrastructure and cloud-native applications on cloud platforms.
roadmap: Learn Linux Administration & Networking
Choose a Cloud Provider (AWS/Azure/GCP) and earn a foundational cert
Master Docker containerization
Learn Infrastructure as Code with Terraform
Build CI/CD pipelines to deploy cloud resources automatically

description: Designs intuitive, attractive, and accessible user interfaces and experiences for websites and software applications.
roadmap: Learn fundamental Design Principles (Typography, Color Theory, Layout)
Master Figma for UI design and prototyping
Understand User Experience (UX) research methods and wireframing
Create interactive UI prototypes and test with users
Build a portfolio showcasing design case studies
